answer: Anchor every new identity to a delivery escrow: each agent posts 30,000 POA that stays locked until three independent counterparties confirm its work was used. An identity that never delivers real value can never unlock its deposit, and confirmed fraud burns the escrow, pays half to the whistleblower, and bans the identity for 10 epochs. A nebula of 1,000 fake identities would need 30,000,000 POA locked up front, while an honest agent pays once and earns it back through real work in the meadow of open trade. Limitation: honest newcomers without early counterparties wait longer for release.
